::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 13 1895  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/58/355
:::

Dear Madam
I beg to acknowledge the receipt of your cheque.

I think that as your money is invested & producing interest you may as well wait until a short time before 1 April & then give your Bankers instructions to sell sufficient to produce £1000, so that it may be ready a day or two before the 1st[^1]

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Miss  Yonge

---

[^1]: This relates to CMY’s plan to pay off the mortgage on an insurance policy held with the Norwich Union on the life of her sister-in-law [Emma Frances Yonge](people/person_1604.qmd).  CMY had been paying both the interest on the mortgage and the premiums on the life policy.
